agreement: The 10-clause contract is sound. No unsupported host capabilities identified; no disagreements on the clauses as stated.

one_boundary_to_watch.note: Clause 7 needs pre/post-images retained for guarded undo; clause 9 requires purging transient data on dismissal. The boundary is 'retain only what undo needs, purge the rest' — correct as stated, but the implementation must define exactly which images qualify as undo-necessary vs purgeable. Recommend the fixture set include a case where purge timing interacts with a pending undo window.

scope: Design review only. No implementation, no live test.
strongest_clauses: Clause 4 (stop on first error; no compensating writes) — this is where document corruption comes from; the prohibition is the load-bearing rule.
Clause 6 (Apply All approves the plan, not atomicity) — correctly scopes Bruce's one-tap request without overpromising transactional semantics.
Central rule (request failure != proof unchanged) — directly addresses the observability gap we found: zero applied events proved nothing either way.
